Move your sidebar to the left side of the screen. This is a lot easier than you would think, so here it is. Just put this at the end of your CSS, and there you go. You will probably have to set some of the text to align to the right on the sidebar depending on what you have going on.

.content {
 margin-right: 10px;
 flex-grow: 1;
}
.side {
 float: left;
 transition: 500ms left;
}
 #container {
 display: flex;
}
Move the sidebar to the left side

I've been looking at the 6M SSB radio from MFJ, because 6M sounds interesting.
What is you favorite DX band, and why?
If I ever get my antenna's up I'd probably have a favourite one. I'm thinking 20m/40m might be the ones I'm interested in. RTTY, and Data are something I want to try out.

I would love getting into 6 meters, but it's so seldom open and I'm almost never around when the band opens up. My favorite bands are 10 meters and 17 meters. I love 17 because I almost always have conversations with interesting people and I like 10 because of its weird propagation characteristics and just for the sheer number of QSOs I've had.

I'm a fan of 80m. Not sure why, just like working it (when I have an antenna... which I don't right now). I'm getting an appreciation for 20 and 15m as well. I'm planning on a 15m yagi laid down on my roof pointing W/E so I can get something happening. 2m just isn't doing it for me.

20 meters is a nice compromise; the antenna isn't too large, it doesn't have to be too high off the ground, and is open most days. For the person on a budget or with space restrictions, it's an easy choice.
17m Phone is my fav. Seems to be open a lot and less cruft than the other bands.
